scene_worlds.lighting: Soft cool upper-left light; stable warm practical reflection at the hatch edge.
scene_worlds.crop_safety: Wide establishes socket/plug separation; hatch insert retains latch/gasket margin. Plug insert must show the separation, not just a cable.

views.framing: Establish the same room, washer, empty socket and disconnected plug. Preserve fixed geography and leave the focal clue clear.
Reframe the same plate toward hatch and visible reactions; do not rebuild the room or interpret out-of-frame people as departures.
